lines.say: three a.m. My wife calls. I'm at home, leaving her. But I'm here.
My phone rang. My wife. She was crying.
She said, you packed a bag. You’re leaving. Why?
It was three a.m. The copy at home was walking out.
She said, you told me to find the real one. Who is the real one?
She had known all along there was more than one of me.
